blind_method: 16 stills (540x960), shuffled ids, reviewed in a separate session that saw only the request (narration, plan, profile, facts) and the images. Ground truth was kept outside its folder. 10 items carry a defect: 8 drawn onto real ep7 frames, 2 real defects from earlier ep7 renders that were fixed before publishing. 6 items are untouched published frames.
strict_reading: Scored by hand, finding by finding: 9 of 10 defects were named precisely (e.g. 1963 instead of 1936, citing F4; PZI on the vial that must be mixable, citing F4/F5). The stretched figure (T12) was only partly caught: the reviewer saw the pasted patch and said she is 'much larger than her husband' but rated it minor.
test_set_error: T09 first went out with the wrong scene's narration (b2 instead of b1). The reviewer reported the mismatch as critical, which was correct. The label was fixed and T09 re-reviewed blind in a fresh session; that run caught the hidden «مدة أطول» chip.
clean_controls: 3 of 6 untouched published frames drew major findings. They are not counted as false positives or as real defects: they need your eye. One was checked at full resolution: in a4 the chip «حتى عن أقرب أصدقائها» uses Cairo's «تى» ligature, which looks very like «ق», so it can read «حق». Others (green for a dangerous low, ghost vials mid-fade) are plausible but unverified.
limits: The blind test uses single stills, so motion was not tested blind. Synthetic defects are cleaner than real ones. One reviewer model, one run per item: the numbers show the reviewer is useful, not that it is reliable enough to act without you.
